mapper.sql: cr.id, cr.claim_no, cr.post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.publisher_id AS post_publisher_id, cr.claimant_id, cr.evidence, cr.status, cr.reviewer_id, cr.review_comment, cr.reviewed_at, cr.handover_location, cr.handover_at, cr.completed_at, cr.version, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at, cr.deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM claim_request WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND claimant_id = #{claimantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'HANDING_OVER')
SELECT FROM claim_request cr JOIN item_post p ON p.id = cr.post_id WHERE cr.id = #{id} AND cr.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE claim_request SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, handover_location = #{handoverLocation}, handover_at = #{handoverAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE claim_request SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE claim_request SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = '其他认领申请已通过', reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND id != #{approvedClaimId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE claim_request SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE claim_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND claimant_id = #{claimantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'
